snippet.title: Snaky Cat Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Dominate as the LONGEST donut-eating cat ever in this cute io game!
Play now on Android or iOS: https://appxplore.com/snakycat

Guide your cat to EAT colorful candy donuts and GROW your cat LONG like a snake! Slither and ZOOM, feasting on donuts and BUSTING other opponents in the arena!

1️⃣ Online PVP in Real Time
Clash with other kitties in a battle royale and compete to dominate the leaderboards. Become the longest cat and crush your opponents like worms!

2️⃣ TEAM UP in Multiplayer
Invite a friend and play together! Rock special fusion looks as a team and join forces to conquer the team combo ranks.

3️⃣ Crush that COMBO
Devour donuts nonstop to rack up those combos and score massive bonuses! Challenge a friend to beat your high score, or play solo and reign supreme as the combo king.

4️⃣ STYLE Your Cat
Customize your cat in the way that best expresses you. Be it wacky, silly, funky or pretty, there are more than 50 cats to collect and choose from! Don’t forget to dress them up with stylish accessories too!

5️⃣ Play Cat and MOUSE
…Literally! Hunt and chase after the fleet-footed Power Mice for special buffs to gain an edge in the competition!

6️⃣ YUMMY Treats
Feed treats to your cat for ability boosts in the next round! Over 30 tasty treats to nom on.

7️⃣ Permanent UPGRADES
Power up by spending your earnings to unlock permanent skill upgrades! Meowwrr!

8️⃣ All Cats Go To EXPEDITIONS
Survive by not crashing into other cats in the zone until the timer ends. Surviving kittens get to go on an expedition and receive sweet rewards!

SO LONG!
